items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Tommy Dorsey was – I didn’t know too many trombone players, but he was on the radio, and I listened to him.

ctx.x: Melba, the first thing I want to ask you: who was your main influence on the trombone when you started? Was it somebody you really like?
No. Tommy Dorsey was – I didn’t know too many trombone players, but he was on the radio, and I listened to him. But other than that, I just loved the instrument. I didn’t need no inspiration.
